title: MLMForge Compensation Plan
description: Configuration schema for MLMForge compensation plans.

name.description: Human-readable name for the compensation plan.

ranks.description: Rank hierarchy from lowest to highest.

PeriodConfig.description: Commission period timing and payout lag configuration.

length.description: How long each commission period lasts.

start_date.description: Start date for the first period. Subsequent periods auto-calculate.

payout_lag_days.description: Days after a period closes before commissions are payable. Provides a buffer for review, disputes, and payment processing.

inhibit_signup_volume.description: If true, volume from the signup order does not count toward the first period.

base_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for volume calculations.

volume_to_dollar_multiplier.description: Multiplier to convert volume points to dollar amounts.

deduct_qualifying_volume.description: If true, volume used for rank qualification is deducted before commission calculation.

RankDefinition.description: A single rank in the compensation plan hierarchy.

ordinal.description: Position in the rank hierarchy. 1 is the lowest rank.

qualification.description: Rules a distributor must meet to achieve this rank.

qualified_structures.description: Which structures this rank qualifies for. Empty means all.

grace.description: Grace period before demotion takes effect.

demotion_policy.description: Controls whether distributors can lose rank.

RankQualification.description: Qualification requirements for achieving a rank.

required_products.description: Product IDs that must be on autoship.

StructureQualification.description: Qualification requirements for a specific compensation structure.

structure.description: Name of the structure this qualification applies to.

max_group_volume_per_leg.description: Prevents a single strong leg from carrying the entire requirement.

leg_quality.description: Per-leg structural requirements. All requirements are AND-combined.

DistributorCountRequirement.description: Requirements for counting qualifying distributors in legs.

min_rank.description: Minimum rank for a distributor to count.

search_mode.description: Search first N levels below the distributor, or search anywhere in the downline.

search_depth.description: How deep to search. Null means unlimited.

min_leg_group_volume.description: Minimum group volume in each qualifying leg.

LegQualityRequirement.description: A per-leg structural requirement: at least `count` frontline legs must each contain a node matching `predicate`.

count.description: Minimum number of frontline legs that must satisfy the predicate.

predicate.description: The condition at least one node in a leg's subtree must meet.

LegPredicate.description: The condition a leg's subtree is tested against. The type field selects the variant.

min_rank.description: Leg must contain a node whose evaluated rank is at least this rank.

min_personal_volume.description: Leg must contain a node whose personal volume is at least this value.

GracePeriod.description: A time window before a rank demotion takes effect.

count.description: Number of time units in the grace period.

unit.description: Time unit for the grace period.

RankQualificationWindow.description: Windowed N-of-M rank qualification gate. The distributor must have achieved threshold_rank in at least qualifying_periods of the last window_periods prior periods.

threshold_rank.description: The rank the distributor must have achieved in each qualifying period.

qualifying_periods.description: Minimum number of periods within the window in which the distributor must have achieved threshold_rank.

window_periods.description: Number of prior periods that form the evaluation window.

TenureRequirement.description: Consecutive-period tenure gate. The distributor must have achieved threshold_rank for the number of consecutive prior periods given by the periods property.

threshold_rank.description: The rank the distributor must have achieved in each of the consecutive periods.

periods.description: Number of consecutive prior periods the distributor must have held threshold_rank.

track_achieved_rank.description: If true, the system tracks the highest rank a distributor has achieved.

overrides_enabled.description: Allow manual rank overrides by administrators.

CommissionEligibility.description: Rules that determine whether a distributor is eligible for commissions.

min_personal_volume.description: Minimum personal volume to be eligible for commissions.

require_order_in_period.description: If true, distributor must place an order in the current period to earn commissions.

eligible_statuses.description: Account statuses that are eligible for commissions.

active_leg_tiers.description: Tiered commission depth based on number of active legs.

ActiveLegTier.description: A tier that maps active leg count to commission depth.

min_active_legs.description: Minimum number of active legs to qualify for this tier.

max_commission_depth.description: Maximum depth from which commissions are paid at this tier.

StructureConfig.description: A compensation structure definition. The type field determines which commission shape and additional fields are required.

type.description: The tree and commission structure type.

pruning.description: Matrix pruning configuration for inactive nodes.

UnilevelCommission.description: Commission configuration for unilevel compensation structures.

broad_commission_percent.description: Flat commission rate applied across all levels.

volume_to_dollar_multiplier.description: Structure-specific override for the global volume-to-dollar multiplier.

commissionable_depth.description: Maximum number of levels deep that commissions are paid.

compression.description: Skip inactive distributors when calculating commission levels.

pass_up.description: Australian X-Up pass-up configuration. First N recruits are credited to the upline.

BinaryCommission.description: Commission configuration for binary compensation structures.

volume_to_dollar_multiplier.description: Structure-specific override for the global volume-to-dollar multiplier.

pairing.description: Pairing bonus configuration. Required when mode is pairing.

cycle_step.description: Cycle/step bonus configuration. Required when mode is cycle_step.

MatrixCommission.description: Commission configuration for matrix compensation structures.

broad_commission_percent.description: Flat commission rate applied across all levels.

volume_to_dollar_multiplier.description: Structure-specific override for the global volume-to-dollar multiplier.

commissionable_depth.description: Maximum number of levels deep that commissions are paid.

compression.description: Skip inactive distributors when calculating commission levels.

StairstepCommission.description: Commission configuration for stairstep breakaway compensation structures.

broad_commission_percent.description: Flat commission rate applied across all levels.

volume_to_dollar_multiplier.description: Structure-specific override for the global volume-to-dollar multiplier.

commissionable_depth.description: Maximum number of levels deep that commissions are paid.

compression.description: Skip inactive distributors when calculating commission levels.

GenerationCommission.description: Commission configuration for generation-based compensation structures.

level_commissions_enabled.description: Whether level-based commissions are also paid in addition to generation commissions.

broad_commission_percent.description: Flat commission rate applied across all levels.

volume_to_dollar_multiplier.description: Structure-specific override for the global volume-to-dollar multiplier.

commissionable_depth.description: Maximum number of levels deep that level-based commissions are paid.

rate_table.description: Rank-by-level commission rates for level-based commissions.

compression.description: Skip inactive distributors when calculating commission levels.

StreamlineCommission.description: Commission configuration for streamline compensation structures.

volume_to_dollar_multiplier.description: Structure-specific override for the global volume-to-dollar multiplier.

dynamic_compression.description: Map of level number to commission configuration. Levels are dynamically compressed.

additionalProperties.description: Level-to-rate mapping for a single rank.

RateTable.description: Rank-by-level commission rate table. Outer keys are rank names, inner keys are level numbers.

CompressionConfig.description: Configuration for compressing inactive distributors out of commission calculations.

mode.description: Compression strategy. skip_inactive skips non-qualifying distributors. skip_below_rank skips distributors below a threshold rank.

cap_per_period.description: Maximum commission per period from pairing.

volume_after_payout.description: How remaining volume is handled after payout.

carry_forward_cap.description: Maximum volume that can carry forward.

multi_position_cap_mode.description: How caps apply when one owner has multiple positions. Per-position caps each income center independently. Aggregate caps the owner's total across all positions with pro-rata scaling.

volume_after_cycle.description: What happens to leg volumes after completing a full cycle. full_flush: both legs reset to zero. carry_forward: subtract highest threshold, keep excess.

cap_per_period.description: Maximum commission per period. Null means uncapped.

carry_forward_cap.description: Maximum volume that can carry forward into the next period. Null means unlimited.

multi_position_cap_mode.description: How caps apply when one owner has multiple positions.

CycleStep.description: A single step in a binary cycle/step commission.

threshold.description: Volume threshold to trigger this step.

amount.description: Commission amount paid when threshold is reached.

BreakawayConfig.description: Configuration for stairstep breakaway behavior. The override strategy nests under overrides as a discriminated object (single_walk or multi_tier).

threshold_rank.description: Rank at which a distributor breaks away from their upline group.

group_volume_excludes_breakaway.description: If true, volume from broken-away groups is excluded from upline group volume.

overrides.description: Override strategy for the breakaway. Tagged on `type`: single_walk for the classic rank-walk overrides, multi_tier for the split-out-count ladder.

oneOf.title: SingleWalkOverrides
oneOf.description: Classic single-walk overrides. Pays the closest qualifying upline (differential or fixed_override mode), with optional generation overrides above the threshold.

override_calculation.description: How override commissions are calculated for breakaway groups.

differential.description: Differential override configuration. Required when override_calculation is differential.

fixed_override.description: Fixed override configuration. Required when override_calculation is fixed_override.

generation.description: Generation override configuration for broken-away groups.

oneOf.title: MultiTierOverrides
oneOf.description: Multi-tier overrides. An ordered ladder of depth-banded tiers, each paid independently to the nearest qualifying split-out ancestor of the source group. Each tier emits its own earning, not a single tier per group.

tiers.description: Ladder of override tiers. Each tier's min_split_out_groups is the count threshold the *earner* (the qualifying ancestor) must meet on their own First-Line Split-Out Groups. Capped at 255 so each tier's 1-based depth floor fits in u8 on the engine side.

BreakawayTier.description: One tier of a multi-tier breakaway override ladder.

min_split_out_groups.description: Minimum First-Line Split-Out Groups the earner (the qualifying ancestor) must own for this tier's rate to apply to them.

rate.description: Override rate paid on the leg's breakaway volume when this tier applies.

DifferentialConfig.description: Configuration for differential override commissions in stairstep plans.

min_override.description: Minimum override amount regardless of differential.

FixedOverrideConfig.description: Configuration for fixed override commissions in stairstep plans. Each rank has a flat override percentage.

BreakawayGenerationConfig.description: Generation override configuration for broken-away groups in stairstep plans.

max_generations.description: Maximum number of generations to pay overrides on.
Maximum number of generations to pay commissions on.

max_generations_per_rank.description: Per-rank override for max_generations. When a rank name appears here, that value is used in place of max_generations for earners at that rank during the generation walk. Ranks not present fall back to max_generations. Empty (the default) means uniform depth for all ranks. Keys must reference rank names defined in the plan's rank ladder; plan validation rejects unknown rank names.

empty_generation_consumes_number.description: If true, empty generations still count toward the max.

volume_to_dollar_multiplier.description: Generation-specific override for the volume-to-dollar multiplier.

ineligible_creates_boundary.description: Whether ineligible boundary-rank distributors still create generation boundaries. Defaults to true.

StreamlineLevel.description: Commission configuration for a single streamline level.

min_rank.description: Minimum rank to earn at this level.

assignment_mode.description: How enrollees are assigned to streams.

per_enrollment_choice.description: If true, each enrollment can choose its stream.

freeze_on_demotion.description: If true, stream assignments are frozen on demotion.

PruningConfig.description: Configuration for handling inactive nodes in a matrix.

mode.description: How inactive nodes in the matrix are handled.

BonusConfig.description: Bonus programs available in the compensation plan.

MatchingBonusConfig.description: Matching bonus pays a percentage of downline commissions.

depth.description: How many levels of downline matching commissions are paid.

SponsorBonusConfig.description: Bonus paid to the sponsor when a new distributor enrolls.

amount_type.description: Whether the amount is a fixed dollar value or a percentage.

qualifying_products.description: Product IDs that trigger the sponsor bonus.

FastStartBonusConfig.description: Enhanced commissions during the early enrollment window.

window_days.description: Number of days after enrollment during which fast start applies.

rate_table.description: Commission rates during the fast start window.

RankAdvancementBonusConfig.description: One-time bonus paid when a distributor achieves a new rank.

pay_once_only.description: If true, each rank advancement bonus is paid only the first time.

LeadershipDevelopmentBonusConfig.description: Override commissions paid on downline leaders.

depth.description: How many levels of leadership overrides are paid.

rank_skip_mode.description: Whether to pay for each rank passed or only the highest.

InfinityBonusConfig.description: Commissions paid to unlimited depth until blocked by a same-or-higher rank.

flat_rate.description: Flat commission rate. Used when rate_mode is flat.

decreasing_rates.description: Decreasing rates by depth. Used when rate_mode is decreasing.

rate_mode.description: Whether the infinity bonus uses a flat rate or decreasing rates by depth.

LifestyleBonusConfig.description: Recurring bonus paid to distributors who maintain qualifying rank.

tiers.description: Lifestyle bonus tiers from lowest to highest.

LifestyleTier.description: A single tier in the lifestyle bonus program.

min_rank.description: Minimum rank to qualify for this tier.

grace_periods.description: Periods of grace before losing the lifestyle bonus after demotion.

PoolBonusConfig.description: Revenue pool shared among qualifying distributors.

source_percent.description: Percentage of company revenue allocated to this pool.

qualification.description: How distributors qualify for this pool.

shares.description: How pool payouts are divided among qualifiers.

require_admin_confirmation.description: If true, pool payouts require admin confirmation before disbursement.

PoolQualification.description: Qualification rules for pool bonus participation.

min_rank.description: Minimum rank to qualify. Used when mode is rank_based or combined.

velocity.description: Velocity qualification rules. Used when mode is velocity_based or combined.

VelocityQualification.description: Volume velocity qualification for pool bonuses.

volume_target.description: Volume target to achieve within the timeframe.

timeframe.description: Whether the velocity window is a commission period or a number of days.

timeframe_days.description: Number of days for the velocity window. Required when timeframe is 'days'.

PoolShares.description: How pool bonus payouts are divided among qualifying distributors.

equal_share_cap.description: Maximum payout per participant when mode is equal_share.

MatrixCompletionBonusConfig.description: Bonus paid for completing levels of a matrix.

per_level.description: Bonus amount for completing each matrix level.

full_matrix.description: Bonus for completing the entire matrix.

PositionBonusConfig.description: Bonus paid based on position in the tree.

amount_type.description: Whether the amount is a fixed dollar value or a percentage.

sponsored_only.description: If true, only personally sponsored positions earn this bonus.

BoardCyclingConfig.description: Board cycling configuration for board plan structures.

cycle_commission.description: Fixed dollar amount earned when cycling out of a board.

re_entry_enabled.description: Whether cycled-out members automatically re-enter a new board.

max_cycles_per_period.description: Maximum times a member can earn cycle commission per period.

max_cascade_depth.description: Maximum cascade depth from a single operation. Limits how many levels of chained cycling can occur.

stall_threshold_periods.description: Number of inactive periods before a board is considered stalled.

inactive_compression.description: Whether inactive members are compressed out of boards.

width.description: Children per node in the board.

BoardPlanCommission.description: Commission configuration for board plan structures.

PassUpConfig.description: Pass-up bonus where initial sales are passed to the upline.

count.description: Number of sales passed up to the upline.

includes_commissions.description: If true, commissions from pass-up sales are also passed up.

PayoutConfig.description: Payout processing and payment method configuration.

minimum_amount.description: Minimum commission amount before a payout is issued.

split_payouts_enabled.description: If true, payouts can be split across multiple payment methods.

PaymentMethod.description: A payment method available for commission payouts.

type.description: Payment method identifier (e.g., direct_deposit, check, ewallet).

fee.description: Fee charged for this payment method.

per_distributor_per_period.description: Maximum commission per distributor per period. Null means uncapped.

company_payout_cap_percent.description: Maximum percentage of company revenue paid as commissions.

cap_enforcement.description: How caps are enforced when limits are reached.

clawback_on_refund.description: If true, commissions are clawed back when the triggering order is refunded.

donated_placement_enabled.description: If true, sponsors can donate placement positions.

holding_tank.description: Holding tank configuration for deferred placement.

spillover_direction.description: How overflow placements are distributed in the matrix.

HoldingTankConfig.description: Holding tank for deferred placement of new distributors.

enabled.description: Whether the holding tank is active.

allow_sponsor_change.description: If true, the sponsor can be changed while in the holding tank.

applicable_structures.description: Which structures use the holding tank.

BinaryPlacementConfig.description: Placement rules specific to binary compensation structures.

per_user_preference.description: If true, individual distributors can set their own placement preference.

spillover_enabled.description: If true, spillover from upline is allowed.
